name: boardgame-rules-mcp
description: Answers board game rules questions from official rulebooks, with exact quotes and page citations.
long_description: Ask Claude a rules question and it answers only from the publisher's rulebook, quoting it word for word and citing the section and page. It can show the cited page with the passage highlighted, and flags official rule changes (errata) that older printed rulebooks lack. Ask Claude to add a game: rulebooks download from the publisher (or you point it at a PDF you downloaded) and are indexed on your computer. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: List installed games, their official rule changes, and the games that can be added

tools.name: add_game
tools.description: Download and index a game's official rulebook, or index your own rulebook PDF (a file or a link) for any game

tools.name: search_rules
tools.description: Search a game's rulebook and return verbatim passages with citations

tools.name: get_section
tools.description: Return the full text of one rulebook section

tools.name: lookup_term
tools.description: Look up a glossary or almanac entry by its title

tools.name: show_passage
tools.description: Show the cited passage highlighted on the rulebook page

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Show a whole rulebook page and the passages on it

tools.name: open_in_rulebook
tools.description: Open the rulebook PDF on your computer at the cited page

tools.name: verify_quote
tools.description: Check that a quote appears word for word in the rulebook
